about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1/rand: edits of the leaf's source that its own tests must kill. Its rows moved from runtime/v1's ledger when BS8 moved the code into this leaf. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1/rand (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger").

mutants.name: ss1-stream-reject
mutants.rule: stdlib.md rand: a seeded IntN is Go's draw, rejection included (uint64n).

mutants.name: ss1-stream-mask
mutants.rule: stdlib.md rand: a seeded IntN of a power of two is Go's masked draw.

mutants.name: ss1-stream-float
mutants.rule: stdlib.md rand: a seeded Float64 is Go's draw.
